mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_score_dimension (version_id, dimension_code, dimension_name, sort_no, deleted) SELECT #{targetVersionId}, dimension_code, dimension_name, sort_no, 0 FROM t_score_dimension WHERE version_id = #{sourceVersionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no, id

INSERT INTO t_question (version_id, question_type, dimension_id, min_select_count, max_select_count, question_no, question_text, required_flag, sort_no, deleted) SELECT #{targetVersionId}, q.question_type, target_dimension.id, q.min_select_count, q.max_select_count, q.question_no, q.question_text, q.required_flag, q.sort_no, 0 FROM t_question q LEFT JOIN t_score_dimension source_dimension ON source_dimension.id = q.dimension_id LEFT JOIN t_score_dimension target_dimension ON target_dimension.version_id = #{targetVersionId} AND target_dimension.dimension_code = source_dimension.dimension_code AND target_dimension.deleted = 0 WHERE q.version_id = #{sourceVersionId} AND q.deleted = 0 ORDER BY q.question_no, q.id

INSERT INTO t_question_option (question_id, option_code, option_text, dimension_id, score_value, sort_no, deleted) SELECT target_question.id, option_row.option_code, option_row.option_text, target_dimension.id, option_row.score_value, option_row.sort_no, 0 FROM t_question_option option_row JOIN t_question source_question ON source_question.id = option_row.question_id JOIN t_question target_question ON target_question.version_id = #{targetVersionId} AND target_question.question_no = source_question.question_no AND target_question.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_score_dimension source_dimension ON source_dimension.id = option_row.dimension_id LEFT JOIN t_score_dimension target_dimension ON target_dimension.version_id = #{targetVersionId} AND target_dimension.dimension_code = source_dimension.dimension_code AND target_dimension.deleted = 0 WHERE source_question.version_id = #{sourceVersionId} AND source_question.deleted = 0 AND option_row.deleted = 0 ORDER BY source_question.question_no, option_row.sort_no, option_row.id

INSERT INTO t_result_template (version_id, dimension_id, result_code, result_name, score_min, score_max, basic_result_json, deep_result_json, share_copy_json, sort_no, deleted) SELECT #{targetVersionId}, target_dimension.id, result_row.result_code, result_row.result_name, result_row.score_min, result_row.score_max, result_row.basic_result_json, result_row.deep_result_json, result_row.share_copy_json, result_row.sort_no, 0 FROM t_result_template result_row JOIN t_score_dimension source_dimension ON source_dimension.id = result_row.dimension_id JOIN t_score_dimension target_dimension ON target_dimension.version_id = #{targetVersionId} AND target_dimension.dimension_code = source_dimension.dimension_code AND target_dimension.deleted = 0 WHERE result_row.version_id = #{sourceVersionId} AND result_row.deleted = 0 ORDER BY result_row.sort_no, result_row.id
